headline: 🗓️ MONDAY IS CLIENT DAY AND FOUR PEOPLE ARE WAITING ON YOUR VOICE, NOT YOUR KEYBOARD — Molly G. on the Willow Point offer (day 6, her thread still holds exactly one message and the reply is re-staged in Drafts), Don C. on the Rena inspection (two written “tomorrows”, still no call), Neely F. on the first real feedback 2127 Hwy 93 has ever produced (day 4, the seller has not been told), and Scott B., who wrote “I will give you a ring tomorrow” on Thursday and is now day 3. ⭐ THE FLEET RAN CLEAN THIS MORNING — nine routines between 5:15 and 7:16, three held-over seller D0s sent inside the first six minutes of the 7 AM window. · DO: open the bank app and read both transaction lists — five minutes settles five questions · DECIDE: Alabama Power draws tomorrow — move the draft date today, or leave it and chase the paydays · WATCH: 195 Lake View closed Friday and still shows no funding receipt, day 3 (re-verified 8/31 5:5xa).

notes: 🔴 ONE ROUTINE IS STILL BLOCKED AND HAS NOT RUN SINCE — the Brivity deep sweep wedged its browser at 4:47 yesterday afternoon and Parts A, B, C, E and F did no work; that is the newest entry for that lane, so the block is standing, not historical. ⭐ THE HONEST SPLIT IS UNCHANGED: the Brivity API itself answers in under a second, so this is a browser problem, not an outage — and the seller-import tool is still simply absent, now eight consecutive runs.

✅ THIS MORNING WAS THE CLEANEST START IN A WEEK — nine routines fired on time between 5:15 and 7:16: marketing, the weekly forecast, the money pulse, the trading cockpit, the letter, the listing-folder sync, the team block, the bookkeeper and the call lane. ⭐ The call lane opened its 7 AM window and sent three seller first-touches that had been deliberately held all through Sunday — the no-touch rule working end to end.

↩️ TWO ROUTINES CORRECTED THEMSELVES RATHER THAN DEFENDING A CLAIM. The bookkeeper retracted its own four-run “phantom contributions” diagnosis outright — the books tie — and named the real defect instead. The marketing lane caught that Saturday's copy fix had corrected the scripts but not the already-rendered images, and re-pointed a live post two hours before it published. ⚠️ Bookkeeping still cannot sign in to QuickBooks — an identity gate, sixth run.

callBlock.why: Seller hand-raise on a Chelsea Park address — came in Saturday morning, first-touch email went out at 7:12 today. He is warm right now.
Helena home-value hand-raise, landed 4:46 PM Sunday and held overnight by rule. Helena is your number-one farm.
Seller hand-raise on a North Port FL address and he typed a live objection into the form — he thinks the estimate is too low. That is an opening, not a complaint.
Back in your listing alerts after five quiet weeks. Overdue since 8/21.
Texted his criteria back unprompted — 4 bed / 3.5–4 bath, up to $300K. A written reply with a buy-box, ten days cold.
On your site browsing for twenty-nine minutes in the high-$600s, and nobody has called since 8/24.
His listing expired 8/21 and you have had a market report on that house sitting ready ever since.
She asked you for something on June 1 and there is no record anyone ever answered her.

listings.status: 📥 OFFER RECEIVED — day 6, the number is still unread, and a sixth tour is booked for Wednesday
listings.note: 🔴 THE RECEIPT IS THE WHOLE JOB THIS MORNING. The offering agent asked in writing last Tuesday to be told the packet arrived; the thread was enumerated cold again at 6:4xa today and still holds exactly one message — hers — at about 137 hours. ✅ THE DRAFT THAT WENT MISSING SUNDAY IS BACK: it was re-staged this morning with the recipient attached, price-free, and it is first on today's board at 7:30. 🆕 DEMAND HAS NOT GONE QUIET UNDERNEATH IT — a brand-new brokerage booked Wednesday 9/2 at 6:00 PM, twelve minutes after Sunday's tour cancelled. 🔍 THE NUMBER ITSELF IS STILL UNOPENED: the offered price lives inside a PDF no routine can read, and the figure people keep repeating is the pre-approval ceiling, not the offer. ⭐ Five tours held across five brokerages and not one agent has ever argued $185,000.

listings.status: ✅ UNDER CONTRACT — closes 9/21, the read is done, the plan is sent, the call is still not made
listings.note: 🏆 YOU DID THE HARD HALF ON SATURDAY MORNING: sixty-three pages read line by line, 116 items sorted into seven categories, and a written game plan to your seller before 8:40 AM. 🔴 WHAT IS LEFT IS THE PART YOU PROMISED TWICE IN WRITING — a call. The record now shows two “tomorrows” and no voice on either, and a full weekend has passed. It is on today's board at 8:30. 🎯 THREE PILES BEFORE YOU DIAL — fix, credit, decline. A seller who hears three piles instead of nineteen items says yes on the call. ✅ Title came back clean and the taxes are current.

listings.status: ⏳ CLOSING — day 3 past the appointment and nothing anywhere says the money moved
listings.note: ⏳ THE CLOSING RAN FRIDAY AFTERNOON AND THERE IS STILL NO FUNDING RECEIPT — no deposit alert, no payday notice, re-checked this morning at 5:5xa. ⭐ THE INNOCENT EXPLANATION IS ON THE RECORD AND IT EXPIRES TODAY: this seller took a check, banks were shut all weekend, and a check settles quietly. Monday is the first banking day since — today either produces the receipt or turns this into a real question. 🎯 THIS BOARD WILL NOT COUNT IT UNTIL SOMETHING SAYS THE MONEY LANDED, which is why the year still reads 23. 📄 And the settlement statement that would end the commission argument is still sitting unread in the title portal.

listings.status: 🗣️ ACTIVE — day 40, and the first real feedback this house ever produced is now four days old and untold
listings.note: 🗣️ ON ONLY ITS SECOND TOUR EVER, THIS LISTING FINALLY SAID SOMETHING. The buyers liked plenty about the house and then named two things: it reads dated for the asking price, and the air conditioning was struggling. ⚠️ EVERY PRICE FIELD ON THE FORM WAS LEFT BLANK — no number, no “too high” box ticked — so this is a condition read, not a price verdict, and it must not be carried to the seller as one. 🔴 THE SELLER STILL HAS NOT HEARD IT, day 4. It is on today's board at 9:00. 🎯 The AC line is the useful half: it is checkable, fixable, and it is the reason to call rather than email.

listings.status: 🔍 ACTIVE — two agents named the stairs, neither argued the price, and the agreement expires 9/8
listings.note: 🔍 TWO INDEPENDENT READS FROM TWO DIFFERENT BROKERAGES GAVE THE IDENTICAL VERDICT — “stairs were too steep” off Friday's tour, and the same answer on 8/13. ⭐ BOTH LEFT EVERY PRICE FIELD BLANK. Two agents, two offices, one physical objection, zero price objections — that is a buyer-fit signal, not a pricing signal, and it changes what you tell this seller before 9/8. ⏳ Saturday's 9:45 AM tour has still filed nothing, now about 46 hours. 📞 The one real ask on this listing is unchanged: the unqualified YES from 8/15 has never been called back.

listings.status: ⚠️ ACTIVE — day 161, the listing agreement is expiring, and Friday's read is now ~91 hours overdue
listings.note: ⚠️ THE DEADLINE IS THE STORY, NOT THE TRAFFIC. The brokerage flagged that this listing agreement is expiring, and a seller's-disclosure revision was requested alongside it. 🔴 THE PRICE CONVERSATION YOU TOLD THIS CLIENT YOU OWED HIM ON 8/24 IS STILL OPEN, and an expiring agreement is the moment it costs least to have. ⏳ Friday's midday tour — the eleventh on this unit — has filed nothing in about 91 hours, and the access question that agent asked (Supra or lockbox) still has no answer anywhere on record.

listings.status: ⚠️ ACTIVE — 45 tours, no offer, and the September block still holds
listings.note: ⚠️ FRIDAY'S TOUR CANCELLED TWO MINUTES BEFORE THE APPOINTMENT and the reason is the most useful sentence this listing has produced in weeks: the buyer “fell in love with one we just saw” and never entered the house. ⭐ THAT IS NOT A PRICING VERDICT and this board does not report it as one — the counter reads showings-by-this-agent zero. 📅 WHAT STILL HOLDS: one brand-new agent has reserved Sat 9/12 9:00 AM and Sun 9/13 9:00 AM back to back, two consecutive mornings on a house with forty-five tours and no offer. 🎯 Forty-five walks with no offer is a price story wearing a traffic story's clothes.

listings.status: ✅ THE NUMBER WENT OUT — and the decision is now his, not yours
listings.note: ✅ THE VALUE REPORT IS DELIVERED and the gap is on the table: your supported range against the number he had in his head. ⭐ THE REAL ARGUMENT TURNED OUT NOT TO BE PRICE — it is what the pool and the lot actually buy him against the comparable sales, and that is an argument you win with paper, not persuasion. 📋 WHAT IS STILL OPEN: his price decision, and flipping the agreement over to Client. 🔧 This morning's folder sync flagged this address as the one gap between your live listing set and the tracked folders — it is a coming-soon that has not been fully wired in yet.

✅ THE FILE IS HEALTHY AND ON SCHEDULE. ⚠️ Two quiet items remain and both are paperwork rather than condition, and both are now eleven days old — the inspection requests have been sitting with your seller since 8/20. 🎯 Two weeks out from a closing is the last comfortable moment to clear paperwork; after that it becomes a rush.

listings.status: ✅ UNDER CONTRACT — roof addendum fully signed, closes 10/23
listings.note: 🎉 BOTH SELLERS HAVE SIGNED and the file has now held steady at inspection through eleven consecutive engine runs — the quietest file you own. 🔍 Only the escrow holdback sizing remains loose, and it is not urgent at eight weeks out.

listings.status: 📅 COMING SOON — 22.63 acres, price ruled at $575K, list date still blank
listings.note: ⏳ THE ANSWER THIS LISTING NEEDED ARRIVED TEN DAYS AGO AND NOBODY PICKED IT UP — your coordinator posted the gate code to the shared board on 8/21 and it has sat in Questions for Gene with zero comments ever since. It is today's escalation item for exactly that reason. 📋 STILL OPEN BEHIND IT: the perc documentation and the covenants. ⭐ The price is ruled; everything blocking the launch is paperwork and one unread board card.

listings.status: 🔥 ACTIVE — price cut live, no tours in the window, and this morning the wrong-claim card was caught and replaced
listings.note: 🔧 A REAL CATCH THIS MORNING, TWO AND A HALF HOURS BEFORE IT PUBLISHED: this listing's branded card had been rendered last week carrying an overstated sales claim, and it was attached to a post scheduled to go out at 7:30 today. The card was re-rendered, re-hosted and the post re-pointed before it fired. ⚠️ WHAT IS STILL YOURS TO FIX: a post from 8/20 still shows the old price, and only you can delete it — the machine cannot reach that account.

listings.status: 🔥 ACTIVE at $599K — highest lead yield you own, and the buy-boxes keep getting clearer
listings.note: 🔍 THE FURTHEST-ALONG BUYER ANSWERED AND IT IS A NO — he wants un-entitled acreage. ⭐ THAT IS A BUY-BOX, NOT A REJECTION, and it is worth more than a maybe: it tells you which builder profile to stop pitching and which to chase. 📤 The document package went to a builder on Thursday, and per your own rule it went without mentioning perc.

listings.status: 📭 COMING SOON — live since Sunday and still nothing booked
listings.note: 📭 IT WENT LIVE ON A SUNDAY AND ENDED THE DAY WITH AN EMPTY CALENDAR — no request, no confirmation, no cancellation. ⏳ TODAY IS THE FIRST REAL TEST. Willow Point is the whole argument for the first hours mattering: it sat for three days with paid ads and no tours, then took five bookings and a buyer-signed offer in eleven days once the market found it. 🎉 Publishing is back online, so this one gets the launch the last one had to earn the hard way.

pipeline.paceProjection: 📈 THE WEEKLY FORECAST RAN AT 5:51 THIS MORNING AND THE NUMBER IS 23 OF 45 — seven behind pace, re-derived live rather than carried. ⏳ NUMBER TWENTY-FOUR CLOSED ON PAPER FRIDAY AND THIS BOARD IS STILL COUNTING 23, DELIBERATELY: three days past the appointment hour and nothing anywhere says the money moved. A scheduled closing is not a closed one. Today is the first banking day since — the moment a funding receipt lands, this line goes to 24. 📊 WHAT IT MOVES: at day 243, 23 closings annualises to about 34.6 — a third straight day under the 35 survive line; twenty-four takes the run rate past 36. 🔮 WHAT THE BOARD ITSELF PROJECTS: 4.70 expected closings and about $40,775 of GCI weighted across the open files — that is the machine's own read, not a wish. ⏳ BEHIND IT: 198 Rena with a clean commitment closing 9/21, 225 Willow Point holding a buyer-signed offer nobody has opened, 3350 Altamont on 9/14, and 1709 Fieldstone on 10/23 outside the window. Anything closing inside 2026 must be under contract by roughly Oct 31 — that is nine weeks from today. 👥 Team pace is 37 against 90 as of the latest verified sheet; the 35-of-90 figure that circulated last week was wrong and has been corrected.

money.note: 🔴 THE MONEY PULSE FIRED AN ACTION-REQUIRED ALERT AT 5:5xa AND IT IS THE REAL KIND. A returned item on the personal account is now CONFIRMED for 8/28 — the second inside five days — after a 96-hour scan that deliberately widened across the weekend gap and opened every alert body rather than reading subject lines. ⚠️ TOMORROW IS A DRAFT DATE AND THE BUSINESS BALANCE THAT WOULD COVER IT IS SIXTY HOURS STALE — which by this desk's own rule makes it formally UNKNOWN, not low. ✅ ONE ALARM RETIRED HONESTLY: the insurance bounce that ran as a red flag for two days turned out to have drafted from the business account and cleared. The correction was printed rather than quietly dropped. 🎯 TODAY IS THE LAST BANKING DAY BEFORE THE DRAW, which is why reading both transaction lists yourself is the single highest-value five minutes on the board — no routine can see inside those accounts.

isa.decayPolicy: 🔍 41 OPEN ROWS IN THE CALL LANE THIS MORNING, 16 OF THEM P1 AND 33 DUE OR OVERDUE — counted twice by two independent queries, both agreeing. ⚠️ THAT IS A CORRECTION TO THIS BOARD: last night it printed 131, which was counting well beyond this section. The lane itself is 41. ⭐ WHAT THE PILE ACTUALLY IS MATTERS MORE THAN ITS SIZE — the weekly sweep put a number on it: dozens of the overdue rows are named human beings with phone numbers who raised a hand about one of YOUR listings and have never been called. Median wait four days, oldest fourteen. That is not a backlog, it is a queue of people. 🔴 THE OLDEST SELLER ROWS ARE IN HELENA, your number-one farm zip — one asked what her house was worth, another tagged himself ‘call me’ to sell in March. Neither has ever been called. ⚖️ AND A ONE-WORD RULING IS STILL WAITING ON YOU about whether this board should auto-expire at all — asked on 8/16, and the pile has roughly tripled since.
isa.sweepCadence: every 20 to 30 minutes while the fleet is up — thirty sweeps logged yesterday and the lane opened its 7 AM window on the dot this morning. 📤 THE FIRST SIX MINUTES OF THE WINDOW DID THE DAY'S BEST WORK: three seller first-touches that had been held all through Sunday went out at 7:12, each one screened against the stop-request and reply-handoff registers before it sent. Nothing was emailed on a Sunday and nothing was lost by waiting. ✅ SATURDAY NIGHT'S CATCH IS WORTH KNOWING ABOUT: a run found seven expired follow-up arcs whose emails had provably already been sent but carried no receipt in state — which would have re-sent all seven to the same people. It wrote the missing receipts instead. That is a duplicate-send trap the normal dedupe does not catch. 🔧 A second run widened the overnight lookback after proving a Saturday-evening lead would have had to survive 34 hours against a 24-hour query, then measured the hidden band and confirmed nothing had actually been lost. 🔴 The one standing block is the Brivity deep sweep — browser wedged since 4:47 yesterday, five of its seven parts idle.
